newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Swiss man killed in Colombia's "murder capital".
newsitem.headline: Swiss man killed in Colombia's "murder capital".

text.p: A Swiss man was shot and killed on Wednesday by an unidentified gunman in Colombia's notoriously violent northwest city of Medellin, authorities said.
Police said Jean Philipe Gaillard, 48, was riddled with seven gunshots by one of two men aboard a motorcycle who pulled up alongside his taxi in the working-class district of Manrique.

Police and Swiss embassy officials said they had no immediate word on possible motives for the killing of Gaillard, who had been living in Colombia for at least 4-1/2 years and was from Sergey in Switzerland's canton of Vaud.

Colombia has the highest murder rate in Latin America and Medellin has long been known as its deadliest metropolitan area. A total of 5,245 murders occurred in the city of about 2 million people last year alone -- a daily average of more than 14.
